findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext in pkg/plugins/log/fake.go returns NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so with this fake the Info call goes to a throwaway instance and the injected TestLogger never records Calls/Message/Ctx. Any test asserting on the original logger will see zero calls and cannot verify logging.

findings.title: Missing nil guard causes panic on nil request
findings.body: ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData/CallResource/CheckHealth/CollectMetrics in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go dereference req (e.g. req.PluginContext) without checking req == nil. LoggerMiddleware in the same package explicitly handles nil requests, proving nil can occur. With the new ordering the contextual middleware runs before the logger middleware, so a nil request panics instead of being passed through.

findings.title: traceID no longer logged for plugin requests
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware.logRequest in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go removed the explicit traceID, pluginId, endpoint, dsName/dsUID, uname fields and now relies only on m.logger.FromContext(ctx). The new instrumentContext only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname and never adds traceID. The result is Plugin Request Completed logs lose traceID correlation that was previously added via tracing.TraceIDFromContext.

findings.title: Adding FromContext breaks Logger implementers
findings.body: The Logger interface in pkg/plugins/log/ifaces.go gains a new required method FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger. Any out-of-tree implementation of plugins/log.Logger that previously satisfied the interface will fail to compile after this change. This is a breaking API contract change introduced as a chore/rename.
